title: (Pwn2Own) Lexmark CX532adwe esfhelper Untrusted Search Path Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Lexmark CX532adwe printers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the esfhelper binary. The issue results from executing a program from an untrusted location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
